finding: Export Freeze v1 validates every supplied parent_admission_ref but does not require the parent_admission_refs array to be non-empty. A request with valid manuscript/artifact/proof/rights/privacy/provenance evidence and zero parent admission refs can therefore append an EXPORT_RELEASE. This violates the end-to-end requirement that provider technical success alone cannot freeze and the Export Freeze contract requirement that required parent admission refs participate in the freeze gate.
root_cause: validateRequestShape requires parent_admission_refs to be an array but not a non-empty array.
validateAdmissions iterates supplied refs but has no minimum-cardinality guard.
All technical/currentness gates can pass while no parent admission authority is referenced.
scope_clarification: This finding does not make author_decision_refs universally mandatory. Export Freeze v1 explicitly allows configured author-decision requirements to be conditional. The mandatory missing boundary proven here is at least one exact current parent admission reference; any supplied or configured author decisions remain independently validated.

qualified_v1_preservation.rule: Do not modify, relabel, or transfer the exact-SHA Export Freeze v1 qualification.

requirements: require parent_admission_refs to contain at least one unique non-empty reference before delegating freezeExport
delegate all admission-state, source/artifact/proof/rights/privacy/provenance, idempotency and append-only validation to Export Freeze v1
do not make provider SUCCESS an admission substitute
do not synthesize an author decision or make author_decision_refs universally mandatory beyond configured requirements
do not change lifecycle state or publication authority

research_gate.reason: This is an internal minimum-cardinality authority/custody defect against the existing Export Freeze contract, not a new publishing or document standard.
